tranches.name: DDTL 3.0 Facility (delayed draw term loan)
tranches.secured_by: Substantially all assets of CCAC VII and a pledge of 100% of the equity interests in CCAC VII held by CCAC VII HoldCo LLC; CCAC VII obligations guaranteed by CoreWeave, Inc.
tranches.quote: providing for a $2.6 billion delayed draw term loan facility (the “DDTL 3.0 Facility”).

proceeds.quote: The DDTL 3.0 Facility was entered into primarily to finance capital expenditures required to perform a customer contract, including the acquisition of GPU servers and related infrastructure.
